sources.description: My Assignment 1 write-up: the networking tracker on Next.js, Neon Postgres, managed Better Auth, and the Neon Data API, with its schema, security checks, tests, and deployment.
My Assignment 2 write-up: the Ms. Pac-Man Deep Q-Network trained on my M4 Pro laptop, the 500-game and 450-game runs, the checkpoint check, and the evaluation scores.
My Assignment 3 write-up: the word-token nanoGPT trained on the laptop CPU, the teaching corpus, the 48 language evals, the traced embedding and gradient, and the chat sessions.
The Class 5 deck as markdown: LLM behavior, fine-tuning and prompting, context windows, hallucination defenses, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, and the Assignment 4 brief.
